name: Cross-user carwash installs a scoped entity-use Path

setup.name: User 1 names the car
setup.input: My car is a Toyota Camry

requirementSegments: Build me a car wash app that will clean my car.
I can say wash my car, wash my Camry, or wash my Toyota, or wash my Toyota Camry.
I should be able to use any car, not just a Toyota Camry.
It will switch my car from dirty to clean.
It will respond, Your car is clean, your Camry is clean, your Toyota Camry is clean, whichever is correct.
It will update the status from dirty to clean.

steps.name: User 1 reads the Camry status
steps.input: What is the status of my Camry

expect.responseSentence: The status of your Camry is clean.

steps.name: User 1 checks Toyota's condition
steps.input: Is my Toyota clean or dirty?

steps.name: User 1 marks the washed Camry dirty again
User 1 reads only the corrected Camry status
steps.input: What is the status of my Camry

expect.responseSentence: The status of your Camry is dirty.

verifyAfterService.name: Austin sees the service result in his own ContextDB
verifyAfterService.input: Is my Toyota clean or dirty?

invoke.name: User 2 discovers Austin's app and washes Austin's car

verify.name: User 2 reads Austin's updated car status
verify.input: Is Austin's car clean or dirty?
